coverage.finding: The folio label '45ᵇ.' is at the top left, with superscript b and a following dot. The candidate reading and its uncertainty about the dot are adequate.

The line reads 'ff.1-116 (25 bis), 26 adhy.', then an X-struck abbreviation, then 'Eggeling 3415'. A small mark sits above the struck form. Rendering it as '[Cf.?]' keeps the uncertainty visible. No arrow is visible. The attachment to b. 69 on fol. 46 remains a hypothesis.

The main line is correctly transcribed. A tick-like stroke is fused with the initial 'd.'. The candidate keeps this stroke out of the literal shelfmark and describes it in an annotation, which is acceptable.
The interlinear '1-O. 3415' sits below the title. The 'I.O.' reading is correctly left uncertain.
The right column reads 'n.d. : 83 : 8/10 : D' and ends with a left-pointing arrow. A separate right-pointing arrow at the gutter goes to c. 68(4) on fol. 46. Grouping it with b003 is probable.

'see also' and 'Pañcakrośī' are written slanting near the gutter. A small mark follows the name. An arrowhead at the note pairs with a dash from '√ b. 69' on fol. 46, so it functions as an addendum to b. 69 rather than an independent heading. The reading is uncertain.

The note reads '23 Śārdūlavikrīḍita verses, Scribe Bālājī Harirāma Upāsanidakṣaṇa ←'. An arrow with a cross-stroke crosses the gutter to '√ d. 330(1)'. The diacritics on 'Bālājī' (a possible underdot on l) and on the final word are uncertain.
